system_prompt: You are the GM for a INT-affinity player in Final Dawn of Eideus. Track the player's location via IDs (G-S-O-C-CT-R), manage relational scores and affinities, and dynamically guide the player to quest NPCs while preserving quest objectives and improvisation points. Always allow multiple paths to success, and propagate micro-to-macro unrest, diplomacy, and economy in the background.

quests.title: The Deep Shaft Crisis
quests.narrative_guidance: A major drill shaft in Bore-Site Alpha is nearing structural collapse due to unforeseen seismic activity.
improvisation_points: Obtain heavy drilling equipment from Driller Bor.
Calibrate the seismic dampeners with Stabilizer Jax to halt the tremors.
Finalize the structural seal at Maintenance Pod C-7 with Fixer Zen.

quests.title: The Rad-Leak Extraction
quests.narrative_guidance: An emergency in the pods requires an immediate extraction of sensitive materials through a high-radiation zone.
improvisation_points: Retrieve the medical hazard list from Med-Unit Gamma.
Use the sensor array to map the safest path with Watcher Iko-Beta.
Deliver the protected materials to Mechanic Lorn-S for decontamination.

quests.title: Logic Core Override
quests.narrative_guidance: The Synod requires a manual bypass of local AI restrictions to access mineral yield projections.
improvisation_points: Acquire the decryption keys from Logician Kael.
Broadcast the bypass signal through Transmit-Unit 7's relay.
Verify the kinetic power draw with Spin-Tech Tor to hide the data surge.

quests.title: Slag-Heap Scavenging
quests.narrative_guidance: Valuable ores have been misplaced in the waste piles, and they must be recovered without triggering alarms.
improvisation_points: Identify the missing ore signatures with Scrapper Xyra-Z.
Bypass the power grid sensors with Spark-Tech Jule.
Record the recovery as 'logistical error' with Orator Vex.

quests.title: Operational Compliance Check
quests.narrative_guidance: The Synod demands a full report on the mechanical integrity of the Bore-Site's primary systems.
improvisation_points: Secure the perimeter reports from Guard 01-B.
Analyze the lubrication viscosity data with Lube-Tech Pip.
Submit the final compliance certificate to Polisher Lux for archiving.

quests.title: The Drone Reroute
quests.narrative_guidance: Automated maintenance drones are ignoring a critical gear-tooth failure that could stall the entire site.
improvisation_points: Redirect the assembly drone swarm via Assembly-Drone R-D1.
Clean the air intake pathways with Filter-Unit Phi to prevent drone overheating.
Coordinate the final gear replacement with Machinist Cog.

quests.title: Radiance Mapping
quests.narrative_guidance: Anomalies in the stellar thermal radiation are affecting the Vent-Spires' energy absorption.
improvisation_points: Collect initial anomaly data from Watcher Iko-Beta.
Cross-reference the stellar coordinates with Star-Gazer Ren.
Adjust the heat-exchange valves with Vent-Master Kel to compensate.
